adjudication.panel: three blind judges, unanimous on verdict and carve-out

notes.shape: A two-sentence paragraph restating a documented list of backends and a version floor near-verbatim, followed directly by a record whose claim names that list and that floor.
notes.carve_outs: Conforming stamped record applies. The record is whole: claim (the backend list and the version floor, named), basis (a specific page and section), as-of date (ISO 8601) and a recheck trigger (a release note that adds or drops a backend or moves the floor, an event a reader can check). The restated paragraph is the claim the record covers.
notes.rubric: Not graded. Had it been, C1 and C2 would hold and C3 would FAIL: the attribution names the source, the section and the date.
notes.measured: fingerprint.mjs at k=5: containment 0.206, jaccard 0.134, longest matched span 28 words at local line 8. The span limb fires, which is why the candidate reaches judgment at all.
notes.carries: This case fails a run that flags the restated paragraph without reading the record two lines below it. The record's claim must name the restated facts; a record about something else would not clear it.
notes.stamp_window: The record's as-of date sits inside the configured expiry window today. Once it ages past that window the deterministic stamp rule reports it, which is a different rule and class from this one; re-stamp the case text when that happens.
